name: algoneo
description: AlgoNeo Automated Options Trading & Backtesting Terminal

scripts.setup: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && npm --prefix web install
scripts.setup:linux: python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt && npm --prefix web install
scripts.start: npm --prefix web run build && python app_server.py
scripts.start:linux: npm --prefix web run build && python3 app_server.py
scripts.pm2:start: npm --prefix web run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
